newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia tin price surges on strong buying.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia tin price surges on strong buying.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price surged 45 cents to 14.86 ringgit ($6.00) a kg after tracking recent gains on the London Metal Exchange (LME), said traders.
"The price should have gone up yesterday (Wednesday) itself based on the LME's strength, but it held back and looked cheap and attractive today," said a trader.

Dealers said the market was flooded with European, Japanese and local buyers, who bid for 415 tonnes against offers of 78. Final turnover was 160 tonnes vs 90 on Wednesday. The price against London was at a premium of $90 against a discount of $65 previously.($1=2.4800)-- K.Baranee Krishnan (603-2307509)
